title: The Router Already Knows
abstract: arXiv:2610.27421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models already make a sparse choice for every token: which experts should process it. We ask whether a sparse dictionary should reuse that choice. NR-SAE gives each routed expert a small dictionary and opens only those the frozen router selects. At block 15 of Gemma 4 26B-A4B, after ten million C4 training tokens and across three seeds, the expert-aligned autoencoder explains 0.518 of the variance in router-weighted expert outputs on a fixed evaluation capture. A rank-addressed control with the same parameters but sixteen times as many candidates reaches 0.481, a candidate-matched control 0.458, and an architecture-matched control with randomized expert identity 0.387. A transcoder variant also leads all three controls: 0.432, against 0.347, 0.371, and 0.118. translated_abstract: 混合专家模型对每个token已经做出了一个稀疏选择：由哪些专家来处理它。我们探讨稀疏字典是否应当复用这一选择。NR-SAE为每个被路由的专家分配一个小型字典，并只打开被冻结路由器选中的那些字典。在Gemma 4 26B-A4B的第15个块上，经过一千万个C4训练token并在三个随机种子下，专家对齐自编码器在固定评估捕获上解释了路由器加权专家输出方差的0.518。一个参数量相同但候选数量为其十六倍的秩寻址对照组达到0.481，候选数匹配的对照组为0.458，而架构匹配但专家身份随机化的对照组为0.387。转码器变体同样领先所有三个对照组：0.432，对比0.347、0.371和0.118。这一优势部分源于架构本身：每个专家只写入至多四分之一模型宽度的子空间，因此指名专家即等于指名该子空间……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出NR-SAE稀疏自编码器，直接复用MoE路由器对每个token的稀疏专家选择来构建字典，在解释路由器加权专家输出方差上显著优于参数匹配的对照组。
en_tdlr: NR-SAE reuses the MoE router's sparse per-token expert choice to build sparse autoencoder dictionaries, substantially outperforming parameter-matched controls in explaining router-weighted expert output variance.
